portfolio_rule: Each paper app is a scoped evidence package and system pressure test. No app may promote paper-specific semantics into RTDL core.

rayjoin-paper.reviewer: Antigravity for scientific reproduction; Gemini 3.1 Pro for the v2.14.4 API and release boundary
rayjoin-paper.strongest_correctness: Public-sample Section 5.7 text output is byte-equal to the AuthorOfficial answer; prepared binary descriptors have stable structural anchors.
rayjoin-paper.performance: Top4 prepared-binary six-batch median is 0.328842s versus 0.187042s AuthorOfficial core phases, or about 1.76x slower under the bounded comparison.
rayjoin-paper.boundary: The binary route emits descriptors while AuthorOfficial emits output polygons; this is not whole-app semantic or performance parity.

rt-barneshut-paper.reviewer: Claude external review captured in the verified sign-off
rt-barneshut-paper.strongest_correctness: A 32768-body prepared-state run matches AuthorOfficial with mismatch_count=0 and max_rel_error about 2.11e-6.
rt-barneshut-paper.performance: The narrow resident kernel is 0.8565ms minimum and 0.9283ms mean versus the 2.083ms author force phase, but the broader RTDL envelope is about 2.53x slower.
rt-barneshut-paper.boundary: RTDL consumes author prepared-state arrays; independent tree construction and the full paper matrix are not reproduced.

rt-dbscan-paper.reviewer: Claude external review captured in verified sign-offs
rt-dbscan-paper.strongest_correctness: Bounded AuthorOfficial component partitions, core flags, and signatures match; three representative synthetic partition fixtures also match.
rt-dbscan-paper.performance: Cold and warm diagnostics exist, but no paper-performance ratio or speedup is authorized.
rt-dbscan-paper.boundary: Exact paper preprocessing is unavailable; the UCI 3DRoad path exposes author index-directional border semantics that RTDL intentionally does not adopt.

x-hd-paper.reviewer: Claude external review captured in the verified sign-off
x-hd-paper.strongest_correctness: Seven primary exact-witness cases and three secondary fast-scalar cases match author hd_exec directed input1-to-input2 HDResult within explicit tolerances.
x-hd-paper.performance: Author internal, author process wall, RTDL fresh route/total, and RTDL warm route timings are separate; no author-versus-RTDL ratio is authorized.
x-hd-paper.boundary: Exact original paper bytes, all figures, author RT-core algorithm equivalence, and performance parity are not claimed.

librts-paper.reviewer: Claude external review captured in the final verified sign-off
librts-paper.strongest_correctness: Official-archive point-contains and range-contains count matrices each match author RTSpatial at 14/14; a separate representative PIP gate has 71,626 canonical relation rows equal, and bounded mutation counts match at [2,1,0,1,0].
librts-paper.performance: No author-versus-RTDL paper-performance ratio is authorized; sparse-refit measurements are RTDL system diagnostics only.
librts-paper.boundary: Range-intersects is explicitly frozen at 14 count matches, 2 pinned-author capacity failures, and 26 not checkpointed. Full-paper and Figure reproduction, complete range-intersects coverage, author algorithm equivalence, count-case pointwise equivalence, zero-copy, and Embree are not claimed.
